content: CDC Laboratory Training Courses Sept. 24, 2024 Key points Review information about and access links to CDC Laboratory Training Courses. Core science Microbiology eLearning Series The Microbiology eLearning Series provides online training for public health laboratory professionals in the area of basic microbiology laboratory skills and procedures necessary to identify microorganisms from clinical specimens. Each course is comprised of interactive, concise content allowing for completion during open periods throughout the day. Job aids and laboratory exercises are included so participants may work with a supervisor/mentor to comprehend and perform proper microbiology techniques. The Microbiology Series includes five eLearning courses. Basic Microscopy Learn to set up, use, troubleshoot, and maintain a brightfield microscope to identify microorganisms. Routine Microscopy Procedures Learn the processes, procedures, and techniques necessary for completing routine microscopic examinations of laboratory specimens including microscopy procedures for smear preparation, as well as preparing and interpreting the results of a Gram stain, wet mount, potassium hydroxide (KOH), and India Ink procedures. Basic Culture Media Learn about basic culture media used in the microbiology laboratory. Biochemicals and Gram-Positive Organism ID Learn about biochemicals and Gram-positive organism identification. Biochemicals and Gram-Negative Organism ID Learn about biochemicals and Gram-negative organism identification. Diagnostic testing Good Laboratory Practice Recommendations for Biochemical Genetic Testing: Preanalytic Phase Learn more about quality practices in the preanalytic phase of biochemical genetic testing. Ready? Set? Test! Patient Testing is Important. Get the Right Results. Learn how to safely and accurately perform waived testing. Informatics Introduction to Laboratory Informatics Series Learn more about laboratory informatics with these free eLearning courses. Preparedness Biothreat Rule Out or Refer Series Use exercises to apply ASM sentinel laboratory protocols to detect potential agents of bioterrorism. Biothreat Preparedness Training for Sentinel Laboratories Series Learn about ASM sentinel laboratory protocols used for potential bioterrorism agent identification. Quality Introduction to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments of 1988 (CLIA) Learn foundational information about CLIA and its implications for clinical labs and facilities. Establishment and Validation of a New Test Using LC-MS/MS in a Biochemical Genetics Laboratory Learn how to establish a new clinical assay using LC-MS/MS in a biochemical genetic laboratory.
